context: A dad jokes with his young son about a trick birthday plan
purpose: Teach: 休暇/冗談/貴方/ウチ/仕掛け/カップル/やりとり/グルメ

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: なあ翔、今度の休暇にママの誕生日サプライズ仕掛けようと思ってるんだ。
lines.en: Hey Sho, I'm planning a surprise for Mom's birthday during the upcoming vacation.
lines.style: Conspiratorial whisper with mischievous excitement, leaning in close like sharing a secret.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: サプライズ?パパ、それ冗談じゃなくて本気なの?
lines.en: A surprise? Dad, are you serious, not joking?
lines.style: Wide-eyed childlike curiosity, voice rising with excited disbelief and delight.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 本気だぞ。まず翔くん、いや貴方には特別任務がある、いいな?
lines.en: Dead serious. First, Sho-kun—no, you, sir—have a special mission, got it?
lines.style: Mock-formal playful tone, treating the child like a fellow secret agent.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: なんで急に貴方って言うの?パパ変だよ、笑っちゃう!
lines.en: Why are you suddenly calling me 'anata'? Dad, that's weird, I'm cracking up!
lines.style: Giggling protest with the natural silliness of a young child laughing.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ウチのママ、最近グルメ番組ばっか見てるだろ?
lines.en: Mom's been watching gourmet shows nonstop lately, right?
lines.style: Animated storytelling with raised eyebrows, building suspense like a heist briefing.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: だから高級レストランの予約取ったふりして、家で手作りディナーの仕掛けだ。
lines.en: So we'll pretend to book a fancy restaurant, then surprise her with homemade dinner.
lines.style: Hand gestures painting the scene, voice dropping to a thrilled conspiratorial low.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うわ、最高!ママ絶対だまされるよ。僕とパパ、悪だくみカップルみたいだね!
lines.en: Whoa, awesome! Mom will totally fall for it. We're like a scheming pair, you and me!
lines.style: Bursting with enthusiastic giggles, bouncing slightly with childish pride and excitement.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: カップルじゃなくて相棒な。あと、ママとのLINEのやりとり全部パパに見せろよ、バレないようにな。
lines.en: Not a pair, partners. And show me all your LINE chats with Mom so we don't get caught.
lines.style: Affectionate teasing correction, lowering voice for the conspiratorial instruction.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: りょうかい隊長!でもバレたら冗談でしたって言っちゃえばいい?
lines.en: Roger, captain! But if she finds out, can we just say it was a joke?
lines.style: Mock-saluting voice with cheeky backup-plan giggling at the end.
